newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: OAU tries to defuse Zaire-Rwanda tensions.
newsitem.headline: OAU tries to defuse Zaire-Rwanda tensions.

text.p: The Organisation of African Unity (OAU) said on Wednesday it was sending a delegation to Zaire and Rwanda to try to defuse the crisis between the two neighbouring Central African states.
It said the delegation was led by Anatole Tiendrebeogo, OAU assistant secretary-general, who would hold talks with Zairean authorities on Wednesday and then proceed to Rwanda.
The OAU added that its group for conflict prevention, management and resolution would meet at its headquarters in Addis Ababa on Thursday to discuss the conflict.
Zaire and Rwanda moved closer to war on Wednesday after two days of trading artillery fire on their border and a Rwandan sortie into eastern Zaire.
